name: Mojerry Christopher Sehloka
headline: Data Analyst | Business Intelligence | AI-Powered Automation
summary: Data Analyst and Business Intelligence professional who turns messy, real-world data into dashboards, insights, and automated systems that save businesses time. Hands-on experience across the full analytics stack—Excel, SQL/MySQL, Power BI, Tableau, and Python—combined with practical expertise in AI-powered workflow automation (n8n, Zapier, Make) and AI agent development. Recently completed the Deloitte Australia Data Analytics Job Simulation, gaining practical experience in a client-facing consulting environment. Independently designed and built a personal AI-driven career automation platform end-to-end, demonstrating the ability to design, build, and ship complete data-to-action systems. Seeking a Data Analyst / BI role where analytical rigor and automation skill can create measurable business impact from day one.
